one_line: A literature-review/primer paper surveying energy-efficiency technology pathways for industrial decarbonization across six energy-intensive industries (iron & steel, chemical, food & beverage, petroleum refining, pulp & paper, cement); it summarizes existing studies rather than applying or demonstrating anything in a specific continuous-flow production facility.
